data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: The app's name.

data.name: SearchHint
data.comment: Hint inside the empty search bar.

data.name: SearchPrompt
data.value: Type a city, town or postcode
data.comment: Shown under the open search bar before anything is typed.

data.name: SearchNothingFound
data.comment: Shown when a search has no results. {0} is what was typed.

data.name: SearchSearching
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the progress bar shown while a search is on its way.

data.name: ClearPlace
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the button that deselects the current place.

data.name: TryAgain
data.comment: Button that repeats a request that failed.

data.name: ForecastHint
data.value: Search for a place, or press and hold on the map, to see its forecast.
data.comment: Shown in the forecast area while no place is selected.

data.name: ForecastLoading
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the progress bar shown while a forecast is on its way.

data.name: ForecastThisWeek
data.comment: Heading above the daily forecast.

data.name: ForecastNoDays
data.value: No forecast for the coming days.
data.comment: Shown instead of the daily forecast when the service sent no days.

data.name: ForecastCredit
data.comment: Credit the weather service asks for.

data.name: ForecastExpand
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the sheet's handle while the sheet is at rest.

data.name: ForecastCollapse
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the sheet's handle while the sheet is pulled up.

data.name: UnitsLabel

data.comment: Label of the choice to show temperatures in Fahrenheit.

data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Celsius choice.

data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Fahrenheit choice.

data.name: PlaceEast
data.comment: A longitude east of Greenwich.

data.name: PlaceWest

data.comment: The current temperature in Celsius.

data.name: TemperatureFahrenheit
data.comment: The current temperature in Fahrenheit.

data.name: FeelsLike
data.comment: The apparent temperature.

data.name: Wind

data.name: SpeedKmh
data.comment: A speed in kilometres per hour.

data.name: SpeedMph
data.comment: A speed in miles per hour.

data.name: PrecipitationChance
data.comment: Chance of rain or snow in a forecast row.

data.comment: A Celsius temperature as a screen reader should say it.

data.name: SpokenFahrenheit
data.comment: A Fahrenheit temperature as a screen reader should say it.
